title: Isolation and analysis of sugar nucleotides using solid phase extraction and fluorophore assisted carbohydrate electrophoresis
author: Barnes, Tian, et al.

steps.title: Wash and collect cells
steps.instruction: Wash cultured cells with ice‑cold PBS, scrape with a rubber policeman and transfer the suspension into a 2 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Reserve aliquot for assay
steps.instruction: After collection, set aside 80 µL of the cell suspension for protein or DNA quantitation using the Quant‑iT™ PicoGreen® dsDNA Assay Kit (cat # P11496, ThermoFisher) according to the manufacturer’s protocol; spin, discard supernatant, keep the cell pellet and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Centrifuge and fix cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 10,000 × g, 4 °C for 10 min and add cold 75.0 % ethanol to fix the pellet.

steps.title: Sonicate cell suspension
steps.instruction: Sonicate the ethanol‑fixed suspension on ice with 10 pulses of 1 s each at 10 % amplitude using a 130‑W Pulse Ultrasonic Processor (cat # 9655A09, Thomas Scientific).

steps.title: Remove debris and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16,000 × g, 4 °C for 10 min; discard the pellet and retain the ethanol‑soluble supernatant.

steps.title: Dry supernatant
steps.instruction: Dry the collected supernatant in a Speed‑Vacuum dryer and store the dried extract at –20 °C until SPE processing.

steps.title: Condition SPE column
steps.instruction: Place a 1 mL/100 mg ENVI‑Carb SPE column in a 15 mL conical tube; equilibrate with 1 mL 80 % acetonitrile/0.1 % TFA, spin at 60 × g for 45 s (room temperature) and repeat twice; add 1 mL ultrapure water, spin as above and repeat once.

steps.title: Reconstitute dried extract
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried cell extract in 2 mL 10 mM ammonium bicarbonate.

steps.title: Load sample onto SPE
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of the reconstituted sample to the conditioned ENVI‑Carb column, spin as in the equilibration step; repeat with the remaining 1 mL of sample.

steps.title: Enrich flow‑through
steps.instruction: Collect the flow‑through and re‑apply it to the ENVI‑Carb column in 1 mL fractions, spinning under the same conditions as before.

steps.title: Wash SPE column
steps.instruction: Sequentially wash the column with 2 mL ultrapure water, 2 mL 25 % acetonitrile, 1 mL ultrapure water, and 2 mL 10 mM TEAA buffer (pH 7), spinning at 60 × g for 45 s after each wash.

steps.title: Elute sugar nucleotides
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a new 15 mL conical tube and elute bound sugar nucleotides with 2 mL 25 % acetonitrile in 50 mM TEAA buffer (pH 7); spin as before and pool the eluate.

steps.title: Collect and dry eluate
steps.instruction: Transfer the pooled eluate to a 2 mL Eppendorf tube and evaporate to dryness in a SpeedVac concentrator to remove TEAA.

steps.title: Prepare monosaccharide standards
steps.instruction: Dissolve the listed monosaccharides in ammonium acetate buffer to the following final concentrations: GalNAc and GlcNAc = 1 µg/mL; Man = 9.1 µg/mL; Glc, Gal, and NeuAc = 6 µg/mL; GlcUA = 3 µg/mL; then dry as described for reagents.

steps.title: Derivatize with AMAC
steps.instruction: Mix each dried monosaccharide with activated AMAC solution to a total volume of 10 µL; incubate overnight at room temperature (as in step 6 of acid‑hydrolyzed monosaccharide preparation).

steps.title: Create standard mix
steps.instruction: Combine 2 µL of each AMAC‑derivatized monosaccharide to generate a monosaccharide standard mixture.

steps.title: Load standards onto FACE gel
steps.instruction: Load 2 µL of the standard mixture onto the FACE gel; also load 2 µL of each individual AMAC‑derivatized monosaccharide in parallel to determine electrophoretic mobility.
